thread:
Maria H: Quick sync  stage rehearsal for the CloudScale joint demo is set for Wed 2026-06-10 10:30am PT. Need confirmations: speakers, AV owner, backup demo host, and swag handoff.

AJ: I'm in for the speaker slot. I'll do the 1st intro + hand off to Priya. :thumbsup:

Priya (CloudScale): Confirmed. Priya will do the partner handoff and show the marketplace flow. Requesting 1x PCI camera on the stream.

Devon: AV checklist: XLR for mic, HDMI passthrough, live capture to laptop, ethernet drop for high-bitrate stream. Who brings the capture box?

Kai: I can bring our Elgato + a spare HDMI splitter. Recommend recording a backup on Priya's laptop too.

Tina: Swag ops: how many items for booth vs speaker gifts? Suggest reserve 40 for booth, 6 speaker packs, 4 partner-engineer kits.

Maria H: Plan: 40 booth, 6 speaker, 4 partner eng. AJ 1 can you sign off on speaker gifts? Spreadsheet: https://docs.google.com/sheet/d/REDACTED

AJ: Looks fine. One request: add the new QR lead-capture card to every speaker pack.

swag-ops: Shipping ETA: we can ship 50 units to the venue freight door. Need final venue address + customs docs by Monday. Any fragile items?

Priya (CloudScale): Venue: Moscone West, Freight Entrance B. We'll DM customs contact. No fragile swag.

Devon: Suggested rehearsal flow:
- 10:30 start
- 10:32 AJ intro (3m)
- 10:35 live demo (6m)
- 10:41 partner segment (6m)
- 10:47 Q&A (6m)
- 10:53 wrap and transition to booth

Maria H: Add 2-minute buffer for laptop swaps.

Kai: AV note: include `--no-sleep` on presenter laptop and use 5GHz wifi only. Fallback plan: pre-rendered video of demo in case live inference flakes.

AJ: I'll make a 60s pre-rendered fallback clip. Where to upload?

Devon: Upload to S3 and also keep a local USB copy.

swag-ops: Customs question 1 any electronics? Need HS codes if yes.

Maria H: No electronics in speaker packs.

events-bot: Reminder: rehearsal invite sent to channel. Please accept by EOD Monday. :calendar:

Maria H: Can the partner bring one engineer to join stage for Qs? Send full name for pre-registration.

Priya (CloudScale): Mateo (SI lead) will join. Adding him to guest list now.

AJ: Slide deck 1 final should be `v3` in `/drive/partner-demo/slides/`. I made timing edits. Please don't change fonts.

Tina: Swag packing details: speaker packs = 1x QR card, 1x sticker sheet, 1x enamel pin. Label each speaker pack with name tag. Need speaker names by tomorrow.

Maria H: Speakers: AJ, Priya, Mateo (SI). Devon 1 can you send final names + titles to swag ops?

Devon: Sent via DM and added to the runbook. Also creating short runbook commands to force fallback: `./deploy-demo --offline-fallback ./demo-fallback.mp4`. Will add link to runbook.

Kai: Who stays onsite to own demo handoff at 10:53? I can stay until 11:05 to support booth handover.

Maria H: Kai, please coordinate with booth lead Helene. Helene 1 can you confirm booth lead for 11am?

Helene: I will own booth handoff at 11am. Helene on site.

AJ: One more: check power taps. Typically need 2x surge strips + a 6ft extension. Venue sometimes limited.

swag-ops: Noted. We'll include 2 power strips in the equipment crate.

Maria H: Action items recap:
- AJ: speaker intro + pre-rendered clip (due Tue)
- Priya: confirm partner engineer name + mic preference (done)
- Devon: runbook + security name list (due Mon)
- Kai: AV kit + stay for handoff (onsite)
- swag-ops: ship 50 units to Freight Entrance B, include speaker labels (due Mon EOD)
- events-bot: track rehearsal invite responses

Maria H: If no blockers, full rehearsal Wed 10:30am PT. :rocket:
